name: COMP_052
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (67%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged quality [F6] and ambiguous Benign vs InSitu set [F1] support deferring this frozen section [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 67%, Benign 22%, Invasive 7%, Normal 4% | Leans InSitu; low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% coverage) | Cannot separate Benign from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 32% reliability (flagged), 88% OOD | Suspect input; reduced read confidence |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (top-class disagreement) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 2/5 InSitu (40%) [F5] | Mixed neighbors across four classes |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4, 8, 10) · context · Above-typical score (-0.81); descriptive only (8/20 check) [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Score -0.61, but unreliable (0/20 spot check) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Score +0.52, but weak, unreliable (0/20 check) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Strongest validated score (-0.42; 20/20 spot check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top-risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); uses unreliable normal lobules, mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions (1, 5, 9; 87%–100%) harbor invasion, matching 87%-similar Invasive neighbor `BACH_0134`.
- Flagged frozen-section quality (88% OOD) or atypia mimics InSitu, making Benign (22%) true.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 9, 1, 0**: Highest risk (77%–100%); check for invasion vs in situ lesion.
2. **Regions 3, 7, 11, 4, 8, 10**: Check benign stroma/fat and TILs vs Invasive case `BACH_0134`.
3. **Regions 0, 1, 4, 8, 9**: Margin scores 99%–100%; review quality, recut, and deeper levels.
